hero_summary: Hiyori Garden Tower has two- and three-bedroom layouts from 63.3 m² to 170.67 m², with swimming pools, fitness facilities and two basement parking levels on Vo Van Kiet Street.
overview:
Hiyori Garden Tower is a completed mixed-use apartment building at Lot 2-A2 Vo Van Kiet Street in An Hai Ward, Da Nang. It suits renters comparing two- and three-bedroom homes between the Dragon Bridge side of the river and the My Khe area.

Two-bedroom layouts: Type A 63.3 m²; Type B 69.1 m²; Type C 65.9 m²; Type D 71.93 m².

Three-bedroom layouts: Type E 170.67 m²; Type F 127.47 m²; Type G 131.29 m²; Type H 134.63 m². These are standard floor-plan areas; the contract or usable area of a specific apartment may differ.

Sun Frontier Da Nang, part of the Sun Frontier group, developed the building. It was completed in 2019 and has 28 floors above ground plus two basement levels.

amenities:
Pools and fitness: The second floor includes adult and children’s swimming pools and a fitness room.

Children and shared spaces: The building also has a second-floor play area and kindergarten space, together with a green park and community room. The kindergarten space does not confirm that a kindergarten is currently operating.

Parking: Two basement parking levels provide capacity for 87 cars and 170 motorcycles. This is building-wide capacity, not a reserved-space entitlement for every apartment.

Access terms, opening hours and any charges for shared facilities should be included in the lease for the specific apartment.
location:
Address: Lot 2-A2 Vo Van Kiet Street, An Hai Ward, Da Nang.

Dragon Bridge is approximately 600 m away on foot, with a walking time of about 9 minutes.

My Khe Beach is approximately 1.2 km away on foot, or about 16 minutes.

Da Nang International Airport is roughly 3.8 km from the building. WinMart at Vincom Plaza is about 2.0 km away by road. Travel times vary with traffic and the exact destination.
